name: read-codex-history
description: >- Reads, searches and exports local OpenAI Codex history without continuing work: session inventory, timelines, verbatim user input, indexed search, and rollout identity/fork lineage. Use when the user asks what they told Codex, wants a Session ID, or evidence of what a run did. Not for Claude Code (use read-claude-code-history); with no platform named, start at local-conversation-history.
author: daymade
